crew.overview: Sophie reflects on the shared joy and private melancholy of a holiday she took with her father twenty years earlier. Memories real and imagined fill the gaps between miniDV footage as she tries to reconcile the father she knew with the man she didn't.
crew.title: Aftersun

details.biography:
MUSTAFA OZGUN is an international director and screenwriter, living in Paris. Now working between France, China and the United States.

His goal is to mix different cultures in his cinematic style. He's been working for it for a long time. Thus, we can see the textures of Far Eastern and Western culture in each of his films.

Mustafa Born on 20-12-1987, he is French of Kurdish origin from Türkiye. Fascinated from a young age by cinema and writing, he studied directing in Izmir, Turkey. He made his first short film in his second year of high school and received awards from local festivals.

Mustafa creates his production company "BABEL TOWER FILM" just before the covid. Then, in the space of three years, Mustafa Ozgun made four feature films. He shoots a movie almost every year.

He has more than 20 feature film projects in development.
details.name: Mustafa Ozgun
